repositories.readme_excerpt: # Impeccable The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with `polish` and `bolder`, review with `critique` and `audit`, and catch AI slop before it ships. From your project root: ```bash npx impeccable install ``` Reload your coding tool, then run `/impeccable init` in your agent (`$impeccable init` on Codex). Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto. Full docs live at [impeccable.style/docs](https://impeccable.style/docs). | Without Impeccable | With Impeccable | |---|---| | ![Villa Castagneto built without Impeccable: cream background, a thin serif headline with an italic accent, two pill buttons, and flat vector illustrations in rounded cards](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/raw/main/docs/images/readme-without.webp) | ![Villa Castagneto built with Impeccable: a full-bleed engraved night scene of the villa on its cliff above the sea, a condensed cream and vermilion headline, and a month strip along the bottom](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/raw/main/docs/images/readme-with.webp) | Same model (Fable 5.1), same brief: a fourteen-room family guesthouse on the Ligurian coast. Without Impeccable, it builds the tasteful default: cream page, thin serif, italic accent, pill buttons. With it, the page is built around one picture: the house at night, seen from the water. For a full project, see the [Neo Mirai case study](https://impeccable.style/cases/neo-mirai): a conference site taken from mockup to shipped page. ## Why Inter for everything. Purple-to-blue gradients. Cards nested in cards, gray text on colored backgrounds, a rounded-square icon tile above every heading. Ask an agent for a page with no other guidance and these show up again and again, across models and projects. - **Words for what you want.** "Make it pop" leaves your agent to guess. `/impeccable bolder the pricing cards` loads a playbook written for that one move and points it at one target. - **A reviewer.** `critique` scores the design against usability heuristics and ranks what to fix first. `audit` checks accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive behavior, with findings ranked P0 (blocking) to P3 (polish). - **A slop detector.** 62 deterministic rules flag the tells above, plus quality problems like cramped padding and skipped headings. No LLM, no API key. Impeccable is strongest on interfaces that already exist: point it at a page or a component and iterate. It builds new pages too; see [Build something new](https://impeccable.style/docs/new-work) for how to get the most out of that harder mode. To start, pick one component: ``` /impeccable critique the pricing cards ``` ## How it works Run `/impeccable init` once per project. It reads your code, asks only what it can't infer (who the product is for, what it needs to do, the constraints), and writes `PRODUCT.md`. Every later command reads it. Run `/impeccable document` to capture your existing visual system in `DESIGN.md`, so changes stay on-brand. [More on context files](https://impeccable.style/docs/context). Then name a command and a target: ``` /impeccable critique the onboarding flow /impeccable quieter the landing page /impeccable polish settings /impeccable harden checkout ``` Or just describe what you want: `/impeccable redo this hero section`. Narrow targets get better results; a single section reviewed closely beats a whole page at a glance. Pin a command you use often with `/impeccable pin audit` to get `/audit` as its own shortcut. ### 24 commands | | Commands | |---|---| | **Steer** | `bolder` amplifies safe designs · `quieter` tones down loud ones · `distill` removes what the page doesn't need · `colorize` brings color to a gray interface · `typeset` fixes fonts, hierarchy, and sizing · `layout` fixes spacing and rhythm · `animate` adds transitions and interaction feedback · `delight` adds

# 紫微斗数 · 开源排盘引擎 ### 算法是公开的传统智慧，不应该被锁在围墙里 [![CI](https://github.com/Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Dataset: CC BY 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/dataset-CC%20BY%204.0-green.svg)](./DATASET-LICENSE) **中文** · [English](./README.en.md)
**一、项目理念**：紫微斗数是中国传统命理学的瑰宝，倪海厦老师在《天纪》中系统梳理了正宗的紫微斗数体系。我们希望通过技术手段让更多人接触和学习这门学问。 开源排盘算法和知识库，是因为我们相信：**算法是公开的传统智慧，不应该被锁在围墙里**。真正的价值在于解读的深度、用户体验的打磨、以及持续运营的积累。 **二、项目信息**：基于倪海厦《天纪》教学体系的紫微斗数排盘系统，包含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据，以及一套完整开源的紫微斗数解读数据：**v4.0 解读数据集——67.5 万张命盘 × 13 维 = 877 万段解读，正文约 204 亿字，解压后 56.6 GB**（2026-10-15 发布）。 | 数据集 | 命盘 | 解读段数 | 解压后 | 覆盖年份 | 每张盘解读字数 | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | **v4.0 解读数据集**（2026-10-15） | **674,976** | **8,774,688** | **56.6 GB** | **1950–2026**（只含真实日期） | **约 3.0 万字** | | v3.0 样本数据集 | 518,400 | 6,739,200 | 33.1 GB | 1924–1983 | 约 2.1 万字 | | 变化 | +30% | +30% | **+71%** | +17 年 | +44% | v3.0 每张盘解读字数按 2,160 张盘抽样估算，其余数字为全量统计；两版每张盘都是 13 维。 在线体验：[ouranic.cn](https://ouranic.cn/?from=gh-readme)，排盘、AI 解读、命盘历史全部开放。 > **注：关于六亲判断** > > 紫微斗数在六亲（父母、兄弟、子女等）判断上存在一定局限。倪师在《天纪》中指出：“斗数批六亲本来就比较差一点。”（[2上 · 00:25:27](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1KJsLekEfA?p=3&t=1527)）在传统术数中，铁板神数在核对六亲方面有其独特优势（[2上 · 00:03:15](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1KJsLekEfA?p=3&t=195)）；倪师仍以紫微斗数为核心，是因为它能结合地理、环境与人事进行综合判断，形成“上知天文、下知地理、中知人事”的完整体系（[2上 · 00:25:43](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1KJsLekEfA?p=3&t=1543)）。因此，与六亲相关的分析仅供参考；[ouranic.cn](https://ouranic.cn/?from=gh-readme) 上父母、兄弟、子女三个维度也附有同样的说明。 --- ##
